diffRapid.fileComparison.title: File Comparison
diffRapid.fileComparison.description: Settings new file comparisons start with. The comparison toolbar still changes them for one comparison only.

diffRapid.folderComparison.title: Folder Comparison
diffRapid.folderComparison.description: Settings new folder comparisons start with. Files compared by full contents use the file comparison settings.

diffRapid.fileComparison.whitespace.title: Whitespace
diffRapid.fileComparison.whitespace.description: How differences in spaces and tabs are treated.
enumItemLabels: Ignore changes in the amount of whitespace

diffRapid.fileComparison.ignoreCase.title: Ignore case
diffRapid.fileComparison.ignoreCase.description: Lines that differ only in letter case compare equal.

diffRapid.fileComparison.ignoreBlankLine.title: Ignore blank lines
diffRapid.fileComparison.ignoreBlankLine.description: Inserted or deleted blank lines are shown as ignored rather than as differences.

diffRapid.fileComparison.ignoreLineEndin.title: Ignore line endings
diffRapid.fileComparison.ignoreLineEndin.description: CRLF, LF and CR line endings compare equal.

diffRapid.fileComparison.ignoreNumbers.title: Ignore numbers
diffRapid.fileComparison.ignoreNumbers.description: Sequences of digits compare equal whatever their value.

diffRapid.fileComparison.ignoreMissingFi.title: Ignore a missing line ending at the end of the file
diffRapid.fileComparison.ignoreMissingFi.description: A last line without a line ending compares equal to one with a line ending.

diffRapid.fileComparison.detectMovedBloc.title: Detect moved blocks
diffRapid.fileComparison.detectMovedBloc.description: Blocks of lines that moved to another position are shown as moved.

diffRapid.fileComparison.algorithm.title: Algorithm
diffRapid.fileComparison.algorithm.description: How lines are matched between the two files. Histogram usually gives the most readable result.

diffRapid.fileComparison.inlineGranulari.title: Mark changes inside a line by

diffRapid.fileComparison.lineFilters.title: Line filters
diffRapid.fileComparison.lineFilters.description: Regular expressions. A difference in which every changed line matches one of them is shown as ignored, for example ^\s*// for comment-only changes.

diffRapid.folderComparison.compareBy.title: Compare by
diffRapid.folderComparison.compareBy.description: How files present on both sides are compared.

diffRapid.folderComparison.skipCommonFol.title: Skip common build folders
diffRapid.folderComparison.skipCommonFol.description: Leave out .git, .vs, .idea, bin, obj, node_modules, packages and TestResults folders.

diffRapid.folderComparison.caseSensitive.title: Case-sensitive names
diffRapid.folderComparison.caseSensitive.description: Treat File.txt and file.txt as different entries.

diffRapid.folderComparison.timeTolerance.title: Time tolerance (seconds)
diffRapid.folderComparison.timeTolerance.description: Modification times this close count as equal. FAT drives and zip files store times in 2-second steps.

diffRapid.folderComparison.includeFiles.title: Include files
diffRapid.folderComparison.includeFiles.description: When set, only files matching one of these masks are compared, for example *.cs.

diffRapid.folderComparison.excludeFiles.title: Exclude files
diffRapid.folderComparison.excludeFiles.description: File masks to leave out, for example *.min.js.

diffRapid.folderComparison.excludeFolder.title: Exclude folders
diffRapid.folderComparison.excludeFolder.description: Folder masks to leave out, for example dist or docs/generated.
